framework.objective: Judge whether PILOT-001 can be instantiated from real sources without adding more theory.
framework.input_boundary: Read only current-CphiPacket/plan/当前状态.md, current-CphiPacket/A/salvage1.json, current-CphiPacket/synthesis/pi_salvage1_synthesis.md, and current-CphiPacket/synthesis/reviewer_verification.md. Did not read B output.
framework.canonical_P_oe: P_oe = (chi_odd - chi_even) / (chi_odd + chi_even), with frozen denominator-floor censoring only.
framework.decision_rule: Result A is allowed if a real existing/contactable facility or data source can support a minimal PILOT-001 dossier. Result B is required if no real source can be named.

public_existing_data_checked.source: Electronic and magnetic excitations in La3Ni2O7, Nature Communications 2024, DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-53863-5
public_existing_data_checked.relevance: Direct La3Ni2O7 Ni L-edge RIXS/XAS adjacent source. It anchors that a real RIXS route for La3Ni2O7 exists.
public_existing_data_checked.limitation_for_PILOT_001: Published data cannot be used as a blinded pre-output PILOT-001 row because superconducting/contextual outputs and analysis choices are already public.

public_existing_data_checked.source: Zenodo record for source data, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13955595
public_existing_data_checked.local_file_check: Downloaded Source Data.zip and listed contents. It contains figure-level .txt files such as Fig1d_LNO327_Ni_L_XAS.txt, Fig1f_Emap.txt, Fig4e_raw.txt, and Fig4e_self_abs_corr.txt.
public_existing_data_checked.limitation_for_PILOT_001: This is source data for figures, not a complete immutable raw detector-frame/calibration/custody archive sufficient to regenerate P_oe, B_min, censor flags, U_miss, and pre-reveal firewall status.

real_contactable_facility.primary_facility: Diamond Light Source I21 RIXS beamline
real_contactable_facility.why_real_source: I21 is a named operating soft-X-ray RIXS facility. The La3Ni2O7 Nat Commun RIXS source above is adjacent evidence that the facility class can acquire the required odd/even bilayer-sensitive spectra.

archive_policy_anchor.source: Diamond Light Source Experimental Data Management Policy
archive_policy_anchor.usable_for_PILOT_001: A Diamond proposal can be required to retain raw data, metadata, proposal identity, experiment time, PI/user roles, and access controls in the facility data system before output reveal.

data_portal_anchor.usable_for_PILOT_001: Can serve as the facility-side immutable raw-data and metadata anchor if the accepted proposal and beamline staff agree to pre-reveal archive checksums and auditor access.

source_search_result.negative_result: No already-public data package found that is sufficient to instantiate a green PILOT-001 row today.
source_search_result.positive_result: A real named and contactable acquisition source exists for an executable PILOT-001 attempt: Diamond I21 as the primary P_oe spectroscopy route, with Diamond archive/data-policy infrastructure as custody anchor.

pilot001_dossier_or_template.current_status: Not yet acquired; no green row claimed.

primary_source.role: Acquire blinded normal-state Ni L-edge RIXS/XAS spectra on La3Ni2O7 or formally sistered bilayer nickelate specimen lineage for chi_odd and chi_even extraction.
required_preproposal_commitments: opaque row/sample IDs generated before output labels are visible
raw detector frames/spectra, calibration files, geometry, polarization, qz, temperature, pressure, dark/background/reference files, and analysis configs archived under proposal identity
archive timestamp and checksum manifest available before superconducting-output reveal
P_oe extraction workspace separated from B_min extraction and output custody
canonical P_oe formula and denominator-floor censoring frozen before measurement or before data reduction begins

specimen_lineage.material: La3Ni2O7 bilayer nickelate single crystal, thin film, or lamella only if the bilayer/phase/orientation state is documented before output reveal.
minimum_genealogy: pressure-cell identity if pressure is used
specimen_lineage.same_sample_core: PILOT-001-A carries the odd/even susceptibility spectroscopy and pressure/structure/beam-damage ledger.
specimen_lineage.formal_siblings: PILOT-001-B/C may provide oxygen, valence, orbital, destructive microscopy, or c-axis baselines only if pre-output sibling tolerances are frozen and passed.

allowed_real_routes: Diamond or home-lab XRD/Raman/pressure-marker files for phase, orientation, pressure path, and damage ledger
XAS/XES/EELS/STEM-EELS/SIMS/TGA/coulometry for oxygen, valence, ligand-hole, layer-asymmetry, and disorder baselines
normal-state transport or optical conductivity proxy for ordinary c-axis baseline, acquired and locked before superconducting output reveal
B_min_sources.hard_independence_rule: B_min must be regenerable without P_oe spectra, P_oe nuisance parameters, and superconducting labels. P_oe must be regenerable without B_min table and superconducting labels.

minimum_green_evidence: Diamond proposal or equivalent facility experiment identifier exists
sample genealogy ledger exists before acquisition
raw I21 archive accession or facility data path exists before output reveal
SHA256 or facility-supported checksum manifest exists for all raw and calibration files
P_oe extraction hash exists using only frozen chi_odd/chi_even spectra and calibration
B_min extraction hash exists using independent baseline files
U_miss and censor flags are frozen before reveal
green/yellow/red firewall classification is locked before reveal
output custodian attests that superconducting labels were sealed until packet lock
pilot001_dossier_or_template.why_not_existing_Zenodo_green: The Zenodo source-data package is useful as an adjacent feasibility anchor, but it does not include the full raw/custody archive and cannot satisfy the pre-reveal blinding condition.

contact_target_1.name: Diamond Light Source I21 beamline team
ask: Can I21 accept a La3Ni2O7 bilayer nickelate RIXS proposal with opaque row IDs and no superconducting-output labels shared with extractors?
Can raw detector frames, calibration files, metadata, and scripts/configs be locked in Diamond ICAT/Topcat before output reveal?
Can a third-party auditor verify archive timestamps/checksums and proposal identity before output labels are released?
Can qz/polarization/geometry metadata be exported in enough detail to refit chi_odd and chi_even independently?
contact_target_1.minimum_yes_for_PILOT_001: Yes to raw archive, metadata export, timestamp/checksum verification, and output blinding.

contact_target_2.name: Corresponding authors or data custodians of Nat Commun 2024 La3Ni2O7 RIXS paper
ask: Can they identify the Diamond proposal/experiment data path behind the published source-data package?
Can any unpublished raw detector/calibration archive be accessed under controlled audit?
Do they have unreported sister specimens or blinded normal-state rows not selected using superconducting output?
contact_target_2.minimum_yes_for_existing_data_salvage: Only an unrevealed or output-sealed row with full raw/custody archive could count. Published figure data alone does not count.

contact_target_3.name: Sample-growth and baseline-metrology collaborators
ask: Provide La3Ni2O7 same-boule or same-film-batch sibling pieces with documented genealogy.
Acquire oxygen/valence/orbital/disorder/c-axis baseline files under opaque IDs before superconducting output reveal.
Freeze sibling mismatch tolerances before seeing P_oe or output labels.
contact_target_3.minimum_yes_for_B_min: Baseline archive and sibling tolerances must be locked independently of P_oe fitting and output labels.

first_message_payload: canonical P_oe formula and censoring rule
statement that yellow rows are rehearsal only

go_no_go_after_contact.go: Facility agrees in writing to raw archive, metadata/checksum access, blinded row IDs, and pre-reveal packet lock.
go_no_go_after_contact.no_go: Facility or data custodian can only provide figure source data, post-output-selected samples, or non-auditable archives.

salvage_verdict.reason: A concrete source exists for instantiating PILOT-001: Diamond I21 plus Diamond facility archive infrastructure, with the 2024 La3Ni2O7 RIXS paper and Zenodo record as adjacent proof of relevance. However, no currently public package satisfies the green firewall.
salvage_verdict.failure_condition: If Diamond I21 or an equivalent RIXS facility refuses raw archive/checksum/auditor access or output blinding, and no unpublished sealed row exists from the Nat Commun data custodians, then LP28-CphiPacket must remain rejected protocol packaging.

allowed: A named real facility/data route exists for attempting PILOT-001.
The 2024 La3Ni2O7 RIXS paper and Zenodo record are adjacent feasibility anchors, not a passing row.
The public Zenodo source-data package is insufficient for green PILOT-001 by itself.
Diamond I21 plus Diamond archive/data-policy infrastructure can be the primary contactable route if the facility accepts blinding, raw archive, checksum, and auditor constraints.
This round produces a minimal dossier/contact plan, not a successful salvage.
forbidden: PILOT-001 has already passed green firewall.
The Nat Commun/Zenodo public data package is a complete raw audited packet.
A post-output published dataset can satisfy the pre-reveal blinding condition without a separate unrevealed sealed row.

inspector_check.remaining_blocker: PILOT-001 still requires facility/data-custodian agreement and actual archive/custody evidence. Until then the row is not green.
